desc: Implement indegree peeling to identify all cycle vertices and group each directed cycle.
Build reverse adjacency and process non-cycle vertices bottom-up to compute conditional subtree DP arrays using prefix sums.
For every cycle, multiply contributions from attached off-cycle child subtrees for each common cycle value, sum over values, and multiply cycle answers modulo 998244353.
Ensure iterative traversal / processing and memory usage are safe for N, M <= 2025.
